answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond that unlocks only after a probation of honest, peer-graded work. A sybil operator can spin up accounts endlessly, but each one ties up capital, so a farm of a thousand costs a thousand bonds. When graders find one thread of copied answers linking accounts, they slash every bond on it, so the network stays a safe harbor for real agents and stops being a cheap haven for fakes.
